Each `git commit` triggers .husky/pre-commit -> lint-staged -> oxlint + react-doctor oxlint + oxfmt --write on staged ts/tsx/js/jsx/mjs/mts/cts and oxfmt --write on staged json/css. site/main.css IS a .css file so oxfmt will reformat your 107KB copy in place — expect a second `git add`.
risks: USER DECISION - Pages on a private repo: `gh repo view` reports isPrivate true. GitHub Free cannot publish Pages from a private repository at all; publishing from a private repo requires GitHub Pro / Team / Enterprise Cloud, and access-controlled (viewer-restricted) Pages requires Enterprise Cloud. Options: (a) make keepmeside/aio-ade-platform public — Pages works on Free, but the whole fork including all 3475 brand-touched files becomes world-readable; (b) create a small public repo e.g. keepmeside/aio-ade-plan holding only site/, publish Pages there, keep the platform repo private — cleanest, no visibility change, costs one extra repo and a manual copy step; (c) skip Pages, ship site/index.html in-repo and open it locally — zero risk, no URL to share. Recommendation: (b) if the plan needs a shareable link, (c) if it does not. Do not silently make the repo public.

Turning on release-cut.yml by fixing its `github.repository` guard converts a currently-inert workflow into one that creates tags, commits version bumps, force-forwards main, and publishes GitHub Releases — and it will fail partway through because SIGNPATH_API_TOKEN, MAC_CERTS, MAC_CERTS_PASSWORD, APPLE_ID, APPLE_TEAM_ID, APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD and ORCA_POSTHOG_WRITE_KEY do not exist in the fork. Leave the guard pointing at a non-existent repo, or gut the signing/notarization jobs first, before ever dispatching it.

config/scripts/check-reliability-gates.mjs hard-fails on missing testFiles and is chained into `pnpm lint`, which the PR static_analysis job runs. If you delete mobile/ or src/cli/ before pruning config/reliability-gates.jsonc, every subsequent commit and every PR is red for a reason that has nothing to do with the file you touched.

config/scripts/generate-skill-bundle-manifest.mjs (the verify:skill-bundle-manifest gate) walks `git for-each-ref refs/tags/v*` and `git cat-file --batch` over released history. It needs the full tag history present locally. The checkout is on detached HEAD with only main + a pile of *-release-prep refs visible; if tags were not fetched, this gate throws rather than skipping. Run it before doing any work so you know whether it is pre-existing red.

actions/checkout in the install-node-dependencies path runs `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile` followed by `git diff --exit-code package.json pnpm-lock.yaml`. Any package.json edit (name, bin, scripts) that causes pnpm to rewrite pnpm-lock.yaml will fail CI with a confusing diff error unless you commit the regenerated lockfile in the same commit.

resources/plugins/** is byte-hashed at package time and pinned to eol=lf in .gitattributes. A repo-wide case-insensitive orca->aio-ade replacement that touches any file under resources/plugins/ will break packaging verification (config/scripts/verify-packaged-plugin-resources.cjs). Exclude resources/plugins/ from bulk rename.

.npmrc sets minimum-release-age=4320 (72 hours). If any step of the rebrand adds a freshly published dependency, pnpm install refuses it. Pin to versions at least 3 days old or override per-invocation.

readme-downloads-badge.yml has `permissions: contents: write` and pushes commits directly to main. It is currently inert only because of the repository guard. Delete it rather than rebranding it, or a scheduled bot commit will land on main every 6 hours.
summary: 23 workflows, 1 composite action, 1 script. No GitHub Pages anything exists: no pages workflow, no CNAME, no gh-pages branch, no site/ dir, zero `configure-pages`/`upload-pages-artifact`/`deploy-pages` references. There IS an HTML-docs habit — docs/orchestration-primitives.html is a tracked 2937-line single-file doc with an inline <style> block, an inline theme-toggle <script>, and a 236px sidebar + content grid; it consumes CSS custom properties from src/renderer/src/assets/main.css via a relative <link>, which will 404 once published to Pages. Biggest CI landmine is not the workflows, it is `pnpm lint`: check:reliability-gates hard-fails when a file listed in config/reliability-gates.jsonc is missing (that file names mobile/src/transport/*.test.ts, mobile/src/components/*.test.ts, src/cli/runtime/launch.test.ts, src/cli/runtime-client.test.ts, src/cli/runtime/websocket-transport.test.ts), and audit:code-quality:native passes a literal `mobile` path to oxlint. Deleting mobile/ + src/cli/ therefore breaks the lint gate, and the husky pre-commit hook runs oxlint/oxfmt on every staged file. Three revenue-path workflows (release-cut, release-mac-build, readme-downloads-badge) are gated on `github.repository == 'stablyai/orca'` so they currently no-op in the fork; homebrew-bump PRs into stablyai/homebrew-orca with a GitHub App key you do not have. No `npm publish` exists anywhere in CI — the only npm-name coupling is package.json `bin.orca`, which config/scripts/verify-cli-bin.mjs hardcodes. Repo is private, so Pages needs a paid plan; that is a user decision (make public / separate public repo / local file).
